items.a: You do. Full ownership of the code and intellectual property transfers on final payment. We keep only the right to say we built it.
A deposit books your start date. After that, you pay per milestone once it ships and you sign it off. No timesheets, no open-ended invoices.
The deadline is in the contract, and you pay per finished milestone. If we're late, you haven't paid for that milestone yet.
Anything outside the agreed scope. We price it in writing before we build it, so the deadline you signed off stays the same.
Your code is in your own accounts, with documentation and a set period of free fixes. If you want us to keep building, the retainer picks up from there.

The studio: orchestrated AI agents do the engineering, inside human-owned architecture, code review and security gates. Senior judgment decides what to build, how it is architected and secured, and what is ready to ship.

items.q: What happens after I book a call?
items.a: A free 25-minute call. Within 2 business days you get a written fixed-price proposal. If it fits, you pay the deposit, we agree a start date, and the build begins.
